```{r codeOverallImplicit, include=FALSE}


## IMPLICIT ATTITUDES --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Combine all data
race.tsALL <- ts(c(race.ts, race.tsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.tsALL <- ts(c(age.ts, age.tsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
dis.tsALL <- ts(c(dis.ts, dis.tsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
skin.tsALL <- ts(c(skin.ts, skin.tsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.tsALL <- ts(c(sex.ts, sex.tsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
weight.tsALL <- ts(c(weight.ts, weight.tsNEW), start = c(2010, 4), frequency = 12)

## RACE ---------------
# fit model from Charlesworth & Banaji (2019, Psych Science).
race.arima <- auto.arima(race.ts, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.race <- forecast(race.arima, h = 48)
decomp.race <- decompose(race.ts)
race.acc.MASE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.tsNEW)["Test set","MASE"]
race.acc.MAPE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.tsNEW)["Test set","MAPE"]
race.acc.MAE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.tsNEW)["Test set","MAE"]
race.acc.RMSE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.tsNEW)["Test set","RMSE"]

# fit model to ALL data (combined)
race.arimaALL <- auto.arima(race.tsALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.raceALL <- forecast(race.arimaALL, h = 60)
forecast.raceALLLONG <- forecast(race.arimaALL, h = 2400) 
minbound.raceALL <- min(which(forecast.raceALLLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
meanbound.raceALL <- min(which(forecast.raceALLLONG$mean<=0))/12 
maxbound.raceALL <- min(which(forecast.raceALLLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.tsALL[1]))/12 
decomp.raceALL <- decompose(race.tsALL)
start.raceALL <- decompose(race.tsALL)$trend[7]
end.raceALL <- decompose(race.tsALL)$trend[162]
pch.raceALL <- (decomp.raceALL$trend[7] - decomp.raceALL$trend[162])/decomp.raceALL$trend[7] 
rch.raceALL <- decomp.raceALL$trend[7] - decomp.raceALL$trend[162] 

# fit model to NEW data (only recent)
race.arimaNEW <- auto.arima(race.tsNEW, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.raceNEW <- forecast(race.arimaNEW, h = 60)
forecast.raceNEWLONG <- forecast(race.arimaNEW, h = 2400) 
minbound.raceNEW <- min(which(forecast.raceNEWLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
meanbound.raceNEW <- min(which(forecast.raceNEWLONG$mean<=0))/12 
maxbound.raceNEW <- min(which(forecast.raceNEWLONG$upper[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
decomp.raceNEW <- decompose(race.tsNEW)
start.raceNEW <- decompose(race.tsNEW)$trend[7]
end.raceNEW <- decompose(race.tsNEW)$trend[42]
pch.raceNEW <- (decomp.raceNEW$trend[7] - decomp.raceNEW$trend[42])/decomp.raceNEW$trend[7] 
rch.raceNEW <- decomp.raceNEW$trend[7] - decomp.raceNEW$trend[42]
```

```{r codeSavetable_accuracy, include=FALSE}
## Save all accuracy stats in a table ----------
age.forecastdecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.age$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
age.predpch <- (age.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - age.forecastdecomp$trend[42])/age.forecastdecomp$trend[7]
dis.forecastdecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.dis$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
dis.predpch <- (dis.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - dis.forecastdecomp$trend[42])/dis.forecastdecomp$trend[7]
skin.forecastdecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.skin$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
skin.predpch <- (skin.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - skin.forecastdecomp$trend[42])/skin.forecastdecomp$trend[7]
race.forecastdecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.race$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
race.predpch <- (race.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - race.forecastdecomp$trend[42])/race.forecastdecomp$trend[7]
sex.forecastdecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.sex$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
sex.predpch <- (sex.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - sex.forecastdecomp$trend[42])/sex.forecastdecomp$trend[7]
weight.forecastdecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.weight$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
weight.predpch <- (weight.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - weight.forecastdecomp$trend[42])/weight.forecastdecomp$trend[7]

age.forecast.Edecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.E.age$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
age.E.predpch <- (age.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - age.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42])/age.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7]
dis.forecast.Edecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.E.dis$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
dis.E.predpch <- (dis.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - dis.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42])/dis.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7]
skin.forecast.Edecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.E.skin$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
skin.E.predpch <- (skin.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - skin.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42])/skin.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7]
race.forecast.Edecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.E.race$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
race.E.predpch <- (race.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - race.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42])/race.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7]
sex.forecast.Edecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.E.sex$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
sex.E.predpch <- (sex.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - sex.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42])/sex.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7]
weight.forecast.Edecomp <- decompose(ts(forecast.E.weight$mean, start = c(2017, 1), frequency = 12))
weight.E.predpch <- (weight.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - weight.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42])/weight.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7]

age.predrch <- age.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - age.forecastdecomp$trend[42]
dis.predrch <- dis.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - dis.forecastdecomp$trend[42]
skin.predrch <- skin.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - skin.forecastdecomp$trend[42]
race.predrch <- race.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - race.forecastdecomp$trend[42]
sex.predrch <- sex.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - sex.forecastdecomp$trend[42]
weight.predrch <- weight.forecastdecomp$trend[7] - weight.forecastdecomp$trend[42]

age.E.predrch <- age.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - age.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42]
dis.E.predrch <- dis.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - dis.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42]
skin.E.predrch <- skin.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - skin.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42]
race.E.predrch <- race.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - race.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42]
sex.E.predrch <- sex.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - sex.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42]
weight.E.predrch <- weight.forecast.Edecomp$trend[7] - weight.forecast.Edecomp$trend[42]


ov.acc.table <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 12, ncol = 9))
colnames(ov.acc.table) <- c("att", "MASE", "MAPE", "MAE", "RMSE", 
                               "pred.pch", "pch", "pred.rch", "rch")
ov.acc.table$att <- rep(c("Age", "Disability", "Skin-tone", "Race", "Sexuality", "Weight"), times = 2)
ov.acc.table$MASE <- round(c(age.acc.MASE, dis.acc.MASE, skin.acc.MASE, 
                                 race.acc.MASE, sex.acc.MASE, weight.acc.MASE,
                                 age.E.acc.MASE, dis.E.acc.MASE, skin.E.acc.MASE, 
                                 race.E.acc.MASE, sex.E.acc.MASE, weight.E.acc.MASE), 2) 
ov.acc.table$MAPE <- round(c(age.acc.MAPE, dis.acc.MAPE, skin.acc.MAPE, 
                                 race.acc.MAPE, sex.acc.MAPE, weight.acc.MAPE,
                                 age.E.acc.MAPE, dis.E.acc.MAPE, skin.E.acc.MAPE, 
                                 race.E.acc.MAPE, sex.E.acc.MAPE, weight.E.acc.MAPE), 2) 
ov.acc.table$MAE <- round(c(age.acc.MAE, dis.acc.MAE, skin.acc.MAE, 
                                 race.acc.MAE, sex.acc.MAE, weight.acc.MAE,
                                 age.E.acc.MAE, dis.E.acc.MAE, skin.E.acc.MAE, 
                                 race.E.acc.MAE, sex.E.acc.MAE, weight.E.acc.MAE), 2) 
ov.acc.table$RMSE <- round(c(age.acc.RMSE, dis.acc.RMSE, skin.acc.RMSE, 
                                 race.acc.RMSE, sex.acc.RMSE, weight.acc.RMSE,
                                 age.E.acc.RMSE, dis.E.acc.RMSE, skin.E.acc.RMSE, 
                                 race.E.acc.RMSE, sex.E.acc.RMSE, weight.E.acc.RMSE), 2) 
ov.acc.table$pred.pch <- round(c(age.predpch, dis.predpch, skin.predpch, 
                                 race.predpch, sex.predpch, weight.predpch,
                                 age.E.predpch, dis.E.predpch, skin.E.predpch, 
                                 race.E.predpch, sex.E.predpch, weight.E.predpch)*100, 2) 
ov.acc.table$pch <- round(c(pch.ageNEW, pch.disNEW, pch.skinNEW, 
                                 pch.raceNEW, pch.sexNEW, pch.weightNEW,
                                 pch.E.ageNEW, pch.E.disNEW, pch.E.skinNEW, 
                                 pch.E.raceNEW, pch.E.sexNEW, pch.E.weightNEW)*100, 2) 
ov.acc.table$pred.rch <- round(c(age.predrch, dis.predrch, skin.predrch, 
                                 race.predrch, sex.predrch, weight.predrch,
                                 age.E.predrch, dis.E.predrch, skin.E.predrch, 
                                 race.E.predrch, sex.E.predrch, weight.E.predrch), 2) 
ov.acc.table$rch <- round(c(rch.ageNEW, rch.disNEW, rch.skinNEW, 
                                 rch.raceNEW, rch.sexNEW, rch.weightNEW,
                                 rch.E.ageNEW, rch.E.disNEW, rch.E.skinNEW, 
                                 rch.E.raceNEW, rch.E.sexNEW, rch.E.weightNEW), 2) 
```

